goal: 向朋友倾诉后悔的事并获得安慰与建议

n1.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n1.line: You look upset these days, and I wish you would not hide your feelings from me. We have known each other for years.
n1.lineCn: 你最近看起来很沮丧,我希望你不要把心事瞒着我。我们认识这么多年了。

grammar.name: wish+would 表愿望
grammar.note: I wish you would not... 表示希望对方现在/将来不要做某事,语气委婉恳切。

options.text: I wish I had studied harder in my first year. My grade in advanced mathematics is a real disappointment.
options.textCn: 我真希望大一那年学习更努力。我的高等数学成绩实在令人失望。
options.feedback: 敞开心扉,说出真实烦恼。

options.text: Nothing is wrong. I wish you would stop worrying about me.
options.textCn: 没什么事。我希望你别再为我操心了。
options.feedback: 否认有烦恼,但 Mia 看得出你在掩饰。

options.text: To be honest, I wish I had never taken that part-time job last semester.
options.textCn: 说实话,我真希望上学期从没做那份兼职。
options.feedback: 坦诚说出后悔之事,对话深入。

n2.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n2.line: I see. It sounds as if you regret that decision deeply. If only you could change the past, what would you do differently?
n2.lineCn: 我明白了。听起来你对那个决定非常后悔。要是你能改变过去,你会怎么做呢?

grammar.name: If only+虚拟语气
grammar.note: If only you could change the past 用 could 表与现在事实相反的愿望,后句用 would 呼应。

options.text: If I had spent those evenings reviewing instead of working, my average would be much higher now.
options.textCn: 如果我把那些晚上用来复习而不是打工,我的平均分现在会高得多。
options.feedback: 反思具体且深刻,倾诉继续。

options.text: I wish I could just forget the whole thing, but I simply cannot.
options.textCn: 我希望自己能把这事忘掉,但就是忘不了。
options.feedback: 情绪真实,朋友会继续安慰。

options.text: It does not matter now. I wish everyone would stop reminding me of it.
options.textCn: 现在无所谓了。我希望大家别再提起它。
options.feedback: 拒绝深入,情绪仍有心结。

n3.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n3.line: I know you are not telling me the truth. If only you trusted me as much as you trust strangers online.
n3.lineCn: 我知道你没说实话。要是你信任我能像信任网上的陌生人那样就好了。

grammar.name: If only+过去式
grammar.note: If only you trusted me 用过去式表示与现在相反的强烈愿望,语带责备与心疼。

options.text: You are right, I am sorry. I wish I had told you this earlier.
options.textCn: 你说得对,对不起。我真希望早点告诉你。
options.feedback: 真诚道歉,重新敞开心扉。

options.text: Fine, but I wish you would not lecture me like my parents do.
options.textCn: 好吧,但我希望你别像父母那样说教我。
options.feedback: 虽抱怨但愿意继续谈。

options.text: If I told you, you would only worry more. That is why I stayed silent.
options.textCn: 如果我告诉你,你只会更担心。所以我一直没说。
options.feedback: 善意的隐瞒,朋友会引导你放下顾虑。

n4.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n4.line: Regretting the past is natural. What matters is what you do next. If you wish to recover your grades, we can work out a plan together.
n4.lineCn: 后悔过去很正常。重要的是接下来怎么做。如果你希望挽回成绩,我们可以一起制定计划。

grammar.name: wish to do+名词性从句
grammar.note: What matters is what you do next 中 what 引导主语从句和表语从句,表意清晰正式。

options.text: I wish I could catch up with the top students, but I know it takes time.
options.textCn: 我希望自己能赶上前面的同学,但我知道这需要时间。
options.feedback: 目标现实,愿意接受帮助。

options.text: I wish the semester would just restart so that I could do everything over.
options.textCn: 我真希望这学期重新开始,那样我就能把一切重做一遍。
options.feedback: 愿望不切实际,但说出了心声。

options.text: I am too discouraged to try again. I wish you would understand that.
options.textCn: 我太灰心了,不想再试。希望你能理解。
options.feedback: 情绪低落,需要更多安慰。

n4b.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n4b.line: That is the right attitude. I wish every student realised that setbacks are only temporary, not permanent defeats.
n4b.lineCn: 这才是正确的态度。我希望每个学生都能明白,挫折只是暂时的,不是永远的失败。

grammar.name: wish+过去式表现在愿望
grammar.note: I wish every student realised... 用过去式表示与现在事实相反的愿望,is only 比 it 更委婉。

options.text: Mathematics, definitely. If I could understand integrals, everything else would fall into place.
options.textCn: 数学,肯定是数学。如果我能理解积分,其他一切就都顺了。
options.feedback: 问题具体,便于制定对策。

options.text: English writing. If I had practised composing essays weekly, my score would not have sunk so low.
options.textCn: 英语写作。如果我每周都练习写作文,分数就不会跌得这么惨。
options.feedback: 反思到位,朋友给予肯定。

options.text: I wish I could skip all of them and just graduate.
options.textCn: 我真希望可以跳过所有科目直接毕业。
options.feedback: 逃避心态,朋友会温和纠正。

n5.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n5.line: Keeping it all inside will only make it worse. If I were you, I would open up and get the burden off my chest.
n5.lineCn: 把心事都憋在心里只会更糟。如果我是你,就会说出来,把心里的负担卸掉。

grammar.name: If I were you 虚拟条件句
grammar.note: 对现在情况的虚拟假设,be 一律用 were,主句用 would+动词,是劝说的经典句式。

options.text: I wish I had your courage. Okay, I will tell you everything.
options.textCn: 我真希望有你这样的勇气。好吧,我把一切都告诉你。
options.feedback: 鼓起勇气,彻底敞开心扉。

options.text: If I were you, I would keep my mouth shut too. Silence is safer.
options.textCn: 如果我是你,我也不会开口。沉默更安全。
options.feedback: 拒绝帮助,朋友会很失望。

options.text: Fine, I will open up a little. I wish I had studied harder last year.
options.textCn: 好吧,我透露一点。我真希望去年学习更努力。
options.feedback: 愿意开口,对话继续。

n6.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n6.line: That is a healthier way of thinking. Remember, if you had never failed, you would never have learned to value your time.
n6.lineCn: 这是更健康的想法。记住,如果你从未失败过,就永远不会学会珍惜时间。

grammar.name: 虚拟条件句(过去)
grammar.note: if 从句用过去完成时 had never failed,主句用 would never have learned,表示与过去事实相反。

options.text: I suppose you are right. I wish I had realised that earlier, but I will not repeat the mistake.
options.textCn: 我想你是对的。我希望自己早一点明白,但我不会再犯同样的错。
options.feedback: 从后悔转向行动,心态好转。

options.text: Easy for you to say. I wish you had gone through what I have been through.
options.textCn: 你说得轻巧。我希望你也经历过我所经历的一切。
options.feedback: 语气带刺,朋友会以同理心回应。

options.text: I understand that now, though I wish the lesson had been less painful.
options.textCn: 我现在懂了,尽管我希望这个教训没那么痛苦。
options.feedback: 成熟地接受教训,继续前行。

n6b.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n6b.line: Good. Now that the target is clear, let us break it into small steps. If you improved a little every day, would you feel more hopeful?
n6b.lineCn: 好。既然目标明确了,我们就把它拆成小步骤。如果你每天进步一点,会不会更有希望?

grammar.name: 虚拟语气表委婉建议
grammar.note: If you improved... would you feel... 用过去式+would 构成委婉假设,比直白建议更客气。

options.text: Yes, I believe I would. If I fixed one weak point each week, the mountain would soon shrink to a hill.
options.textCn: 是的,我想我会的。如果我每周攻克一个弱点,大山很快就会变成小山。
options.feedback: 重拾信心,准备行动。

options.text: I wish improvement came as fast as I wish for it.
options.textCn: 我真希望进步来得和我期盼的一样快。
options.feedback: 情绪真实,朋友会继续鼓励。

options.text: No, I would still feel hopeless. I wish you would stop raising my hopes.
options.textCn: 不,我依然觉得没希望。我希望你别再给我希望。
options.feedback: 拒绝振作,朋友耐心疏导。

n7.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n7.line: I have made my share of mistakes too, and I wish I had someone to comfort me back then. Let me be that person for you.
n7.lineCn: 我也犯过不少错,那时真希望有人安慰我。让我来做那个安慰你的人吧。

grammar.name: wish+过去完成表过去遗憾
grammar.note: I wish I had someone to comfort me back then 表示对过去情况的遗憾,back then 限定时间。

options.text: Thank you, that means a lot. I wish I had met you years ago.
options.textCn: 谢谢你,这对我意义重大。我真希望几年前就认识你。
options.feedback: 感受友情,情绪回暖。

options.text: Pity talk is useless. I wish people would simply leave me alone.
options.textCn: 说这些同情的话没用。我希望大家干脆别理我。
options.feedback: 拒绝所有善意,朋友失望离开。

options.text: I am grateful, though I wish I did not need comforting at all.
options.textCn: 我很感激,虽然我希望自己根本不需要安慰。
options.feedback: 坦诚中带着自责,对话继续。

n8.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n8.line: Now that you feel lighter, let us look forward. If you could redesign your study plan, what would you change first?
n8.lineCn: 既然你轻松些了,我们往前看。如果你能重新设计学习计划,你会先改变什么?

grammar.name: 虚拟条件句(将来)
grammar.note: If you could redesign... what would you change 用 could+would 表示对将来情况的假设性询问。

options.text: I would set aside two hours for mathematics every day, and I wish I had done so from day one.
options.textCn: 我会每天留两小时学数学,而且我真希望第一天就这么做。
options.feedback: 决心明确,朋友为之高兴。

options.text: I would probably give up mathematics and take an easier course instead.
options.textCn: 我可能会放弃数学,改选一门更容易的课。
options.feedback: 选择务实路线,同样向前看。

options.text: I wish I could simply avoid making any decisions at all.
options.textCn: 我真希望自己根本不用做任何决定。
options.feedback: 仍在逃避,朋友会再次提醒。

n9.speaker: 朋友 Mia
n9.line: See? You already know the answer. The past is fixed, but the future is still yours to shape. I wish you the very best.
n9.lineCn: 看吧?你其实早就知道答案。过去已经定格,未来仍由你塑造。我祝你一切顺利。

grammar.name: wish 表祝愿
grammar.note: I wish you the very best 是 wish+双宾语的祝愿句式,正式而真诚。

options.text: Thank you. I wish we had had this conversation months ago, but better late than never.
options.textCn: 谢谢你。我真希望这场对话发生在几个月前,但亡羊补牢,为时未晚。
options.feedback: 从后悔转向释然,走向新生。

options.text: I still feel I will never catch up. I wish I had your confidence.
options.textCn: 我还是觉得自己永远赶不上。真希望有你那样的自信。
options.feedback: 信心仍不足,朋友会再次鼓励。

options.text: Enough comfort; I wish my grades would rise on their own. Goodbye.
options.textCn: 安慰到此为止吧。我真希望成绩自己会涨上去。再见。
options.feedback: 消极拒绝,朋友无奈离开。

success.speaker: 朋友 Mia
success.line: Then stand up and start today. I wish you every success, and I will be right beside you.
success.lineCn: 那就站起来,从今天开始。我祝你一切顺利,而且我会一直陪在你身边。

fail1.speaker: 朋友 Mia
fail1.line: I am sorry you feel that way. I wish you would come to me when you are ready to talk.
fail1.lineCn: 你那样想我很遗憾。希望你愿意谈的时候能来找我。

fail2.speaker: 朋友 Mia
fail2.line: Avoiding decisions will only postpone the pain. I wish you would take your future more seriously.
fail2.lineCn: 逃避决定只会推迟痛苦。我希望你更认真地对待自己的未来。
